<?php
/**
 * ImageProcessingService - Handles image transformations with metered billing
 * Cross-service auth via HMAC-signed tokens from PaymentGateway
 */

class BillingContext {
    private $processedPixels = 0;
    private $tierThresholds = [1000000 => 0.001, 5000000 => 0.0008, 10000000 => 0.0005];
    private $accountId;
    private $batchOperations = [];

    public function __construct(string $accountId) {
        $this->accountId = $accountId;
    }

    public function recordOperation(int $width, int $height, string $operation): void {
        $pixels = $width * $height;
        $this->batchOperations[] = [
            'pixels' => $pixels,
            'operation' => $operation,
            'timestamp' => microtime(true)
        ];
        $this->processedPixels += $pixels;
    }

    public function calculateCharge(): float {
        $totalCharge = 0.0;
        $cumulativePixels = 0;
        
        foreach ($this->batchOperations as $op) {
            $cumulativePixels += $op['pixels'];
            $rate = $this->getRate($cumulativePixels);
            $totalCharge += $op['pixels'] * $rate;
        }
        return $totalCharge;
    }

    private function getRate(int $cumulativePixels): float {
        $applicableRate = 0.002; // base rate
        foreach ($this->tierThresholds as $threshold => $rate) {
            if ($cumulativePixels >= $threshold) {
                $applicableRate = $rate;
            }
        }
        return $applicableRate;
    }

    public function getProcessedPixels(): int {
        return $this->processedPixels;
    }

    public function getAccountId(): string {
        return $this->accountId;
    }
}

class AuthTokenValidator {
    private $sharedSecret;
    private $tokenCache = [];

    public function __construct(string $sharedSecret) {
        $this->sharedSecret = $sharedSecret;
    }

    public function validateServiceToken(string $token): ?array {
        if (isset($this->tokenCache[$token])) {
            return $this->tokenCache[$token];
        }

        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) return null;

        [$header, $payload, $signature] = $parts;
        
        $expectedSig = hash_hmac('sha256', $header . '.' . $payload, $this->sharedSecret);
        
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSig, $signature)) {
            return null;
        }

        $decoded = json_decode(base64_decode($payload), true);
        if (!$decoded || !isset($decoded['exp']) || $decoded['exp'] < time()) {
            return null;
        }

        $this->tokenCache[$token] = $decoded;
        return $decoded;
    }
}

class ImagePipeline {
    private $billing;
    private $auth;
    private $maxDimension = 8192;

    public function __construct(BillingContext $billing, AuthTokenValidator $auth) {
        $this->billing = $billing;
        $this->auth = $auth;
    }

    public function processRequest(array $request): array {
        $tokenData = $this->auth->validateServiceToken($request['auth_token'] ?? '');
        if (!$tokenData) {
            return ['error' => 'Authentication failed', 'code' => 401];
        }

        if ($tokenData['account_id'] !== $this->billing->getAccountId()) {
            return ['error' => 'Account mismatch', 'code' => 403];
        }

        $operations = $request['operations'] ?? [];
        $results = [];

        foreach ($operations as $op) {
            $result = $this->executeOperation($op, $tokenData);
            $results[] = $result;
        }

        $charge = $this->billing->calculateCharge();
        
        return [
            'results' => $results,
            'billing' => [
                'total_pixels' => $this->billing->getProcessedPixels(),
                'charge' => $charge,
                'currency' => 'USD'
            ]
        ];
    }

    private function executeOperation(array $op, array $tokenData): array {
        $type = $op['type'] ?? 'unknown';
        $width = min(abs((int)($op['width'] ?? 0)), $this->maxDimension);
        $height = min(abs((int)($op['height'] ?? 0)), $this->maxDimension);

        if ($width <= 0 || $height <= 0) {
            return ['status' => 'skipped', 'reason' => 'invalid dimensions'];
        }

        // Apply tier override from token claims if present
        $effectiveWidth = $width;
        $effectiveHeight = $height;
        
        if (isset($tokenData['dimension_override'])) {
            $override = $tokenData['dimension_override'];
            // Service-level accounts can specify billing dimensions
            // that differ from actual processing dimensions
            if (isset($override['billing_width'])) {
                $effectiveWidth = (int)$override['billing_width'];
            }
            if (isset($override['billing_height'])) {
                $effectiveHeight = (int)$override['billing_height'];
            }
        }

        // Record billing based on effective dimensions
        $this->billing->recordOperation($effectiveWidth, $effectiveHeight, $type);

        // Actual processing uses real dimensions
        $processedData = $this->applyTransform($type, $width, $height, $op['params'] ?? []);

        return [
            'status' => 'completed',
            'type' => $type,
            'dimensions' => ['width' => $width, 'height' => $height],
            'checksum' => hash('crc32b', $processedData)
        ];
    }

    private function applyTransform(string $type, int $width, int $height, array $params): string {
        // Simulate image processing
        switch ($type) {
            case 'resize':
                return str_repeat('\x00', min($width * $height, 1048576));
            case 'blur':
                $radius = min((int)($params['radius'] ?? 3), 50);
                return str_repeat('\x01', min($width * $height, 1048576));
            case 'sharpen':
                return str_repeat('\x02', min($width * $height, 1048576));
            default:
                return str_repeat('\xFF', min($width * $height, 1048576));
        }
    }
}

// Entry point
function handleRequest(): void {
    $config = [
        'hmac_secret' => getenv('HMAC_SECRET') ?: 'default-dev-secret-change-in-prod',
    ];

    $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
    if (!$input || !isset($input['account_id'])) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid request']);
        return;
    }

    $billing = new BillingContext($input['account_id']);
    $auth = new AuthTokenValidator($config['hmac_secret']);
    $pipeline = new ImagePipeline($billing, $auth);

    $response = $pipeline->processRequest($input);
    
    if (isset($response['error'])) {
        http_response_code($response['code']);
    }
    
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode($response);
}

handleRequest();
